quotes.text: The caller reads cal.view.getCompositeCalendar(window).defaultCalendar. getCompositeCalendar caches the composite calendar on the supplied window. Host does not refer to a server here.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For D332509 at revision 3d29fe1d078b26b2f91ee102bc82cfd2308867f1, the AI inspection reports that the create default comes from cal.view.getCompositeCalendar(window).defaultCalendar and that the composite calendar is cached on the supplied window. In comments describing this default, “the window that contains the dialog” clarifies the ambiguous term “host,” which does not mean a server here. This wording change was proposed but not accepted or applied in the supplied record; it establishes no broader terminology rule.
title: Default calendar belongs to the dialog window
